question: Which of the following correctly describes a feature of the Chithirai Festival of Madurai?

options.text: It is observed during the Tamil month of Aadi.
Lord Kallazhagar enters the city in a decorated procession.
It is celebrated only during the New Year week.
The festival concludes with traditional wrestling events.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Kallazhagar enters the city in a decorated procession**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chithirai Festival:** Celebrated in **Madurai**, Tamil Nadu, this festival is one of the most famous and grand temple festivals in India.
 
• The highlight of the festival is the **procession of Lord Kallazhagar** (an incarnation of Lord Vishnu) entering the Vaigai River and the city. This procession is a significant event and attracts thousands of devotees. *Hence, statement 2 is correct.*
 
• The festival takes place during the **Tamil month of Chithirai** (April–May) and not during the month of **Aadi**. *Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.*
 
• It is celebrated for several days and is not limited to the **New Year week**. The grandeur and rituals span across multiple days. *Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.*
 
• Although various cultural events are organized, **traditional wrestling** is not a concluding part of this festival. *Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.*
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Lord Kallazhagar enters the city in a decorated procession.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Significance of Chithirai Festival:**

 
 
• **Chithirai Festival** is celebrated to commemorate the celestial wedding of Goddess Meenakshi (an incarnation of Goddess Parvati) and Lord Sundareswarar (an incarnation of Lord Shiva). This is followed by the procession of Lord Kallazhagar.
 
• The festival signifies harmony between **Shaivism and Vaishnavism**, two major sects in Hinduism. The wedding ceremony symbolizes Shaivism, while the procession of Lord Kallazhagar represents Vaishnavism.
 
 
 
• **Lord Kallazhagar’s Role:**
 
 
• Lord Kallazhagar is believed to visit Madurai to bless his sister, Goddess Meenakshi, during her wedding ceremony. This visit is marked by his decorated procession across the city.
 
• Devotees eagerly await the moment when the idol of Lord Kallazhagar enters the **Vaigai River**, which is considered an auspicious event.
 
 
 
• **Location and Timing:**
 
 
• The festival takes place in the **Meenakshi Amman Temple** in Madurai during the Tamil month of **Chithirai** (April–May).
 
• The temple is a prominent **landmark** in Madurai, and the festival attracts devotees and tourists from across India and abroad.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Characteristics:**

 
 
• The festival is unique as it brings together the worshippers of **Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu** in one grand celebration.
 
• The event involves elaborate rituals, including the **celestial wedding**, decorated chariots, cultural events, and traditional music and dance performances.
 
 
 
• **Historical Importance:**
 
 
• **Meenakshi Amman Temple** was built by the Nayak rulers of Madurai during the 16th century and is an architectural marvel.
 
• The Chithirai Festival showcases the rich **cultural heritage** of Tamil Nadu and is a significant event in the state’s religious calendar.
